{{Quote|Sometimes you gotta be scum to catch scum.|Scratch|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Scratch''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of the [[Exchange]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Around [[3640 BBY]] he set up a shop in the [[Minev-Ra Caves]] on [[Voss]], dealing with trade that was illegal by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] standard but overlooked by the [[Voss (species)|Voss]]. [[Ambassador/Legends|Ambassador]] [[Lokir-Ka]] sent the [[Voidhound]] to meet with Scratch and learn how [[Rogun Matt'rik|Rogun the Butcher]] was able to smuggle [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] technobeasts offworld. Scratch put the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] in contact with [[Jela Reneke]] and later helped them cover their tracks when Reneke framed the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] for the technobeast smuggling she'd been doing herself. As the smuggler eventually disposed of Reneke, Scratch offered to help the Captain set up on Voss anytime, and [[Gormak Zak]] asked to shift his trade from Rogun to the smuggler, who instead insisted that Zak lay low and avoid the retribution of the Voss.
